summary: Single-user alpha hardening pass: reliability/monitoring, local backup and restore, database locking, match quality and feedback, ATS resilience, production rollback, and deeper verification.

actions.DATA-02: Built Supabase-compatible logical backup/restore tooling and passed a dated isolated local restore drill with checksums and relational-integrity verification. Production-data hosted restore remains open.
actions.API-07: Added persisted scan runs, stable error codes, source health, serialized execution, and a production-triggered end-to-end scheduled scan.
actions.APPSEC-03: Unified authentication and observability middleware and verified the complete security-header contract in tests and production.
actions.CI-05: Rolled production to known-good 36105c0, smoke-tested it, rolled forward to c6ace03, smoke-tested again, and restored deploy-after-CI.
actions.OBS-02: Added structured request/authentication logs and correlation IDs across successful and failed requests; verified in Render production logs.
actions.OBS-04: Added independent GitHub production monitor and failure-visible scan workflows.
actions.OBS-05: Added scheduled external health and database-readiness checks plus a reusable authenticated smoke harness.
actions.PERF-02: Added advisory scan/scoring locks, bounded lock/query timeouts, distinct-only match updates, and missing foreign-key indexes; regression-tested lock contention.
actions.TEST-02: Added deployment smoke coverage and completed authenticated browser feedback verification.
actions.TEST-06: Exercised migrations, ingestion, scoring, locking, backup, and restore on real local Supabase/Postgres.
actions.PROD-02: Added a labelled golden match set and a CI quality gate; current result is 100% with no false positives or negatives.
actions.PROD-03: Added persistent job-quality feedback and dashboard quality metrics for ranking improvement.
